title: Gate clauses encode the circuit CNF
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with natural-number input count $n$, gates in topological order, and an output vertex among its input and gate vertices. Suppose each gate has at most two arguments. Then running the gate-clause encoder on the circuit encoding produces exactly the serialization of the CNF obtained by concatenating the Tseitin clauses of the gates, starting with variable index $n$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite acyclic Boolean circuit with input count $n$
The circuit's gates are in topological order and each reads only earlier vertices
The output is a circuit vertex
Every gate has at most two arguments
